name: legendary-saddle-banishes-itself-and-draws-into-memory-with-three-horses
notes: Legendary Saddle: banish it to draw into memory (needs three Horse allies).

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: Draw a card into your memory. Activate this ability only if you control three or more Horse allies.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. 'Banish CARDNAME' is the ability's cost but nothing paid it (no GAFieldAbilityCostTable() entry): the item stayed on the field and the ability was free and repeatable. Added the spec.
